title: With Invoicing and Part Sales View only, only part sale invoices link
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access", "Invoicing & Payments → View", "Part Sales → View" but not "Work Orders → View".
  • Have a customer with an overdue work order invoice A and an overdue part sale invoice B, both made at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that customer's group expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Look at invoice A's number.
  2. Click invoice B's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Invoice A's number is plain text: the role lacks "Work Orders → View".

Step 2:

  • The part sale's finance page opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-N2: “A document the user lacks the permission for shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R2: “An invoice or part sale at the user's current location opens its finance page, as today.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “An invoice or part sale opens for a user with 'Invoicing & Payments → View' and 'Work Orders → View' (work orders) or 'Part Sales → View' (part sales).”
